title: Lunar Dust Findings
description: A stone tower and observatory perched on a cliff edge overlooks a vast fantasy landscape with a winding river and distant castle. Two winged figures examine a large detailed map spread on the stone platform while magical blue banners, floating books, and swirling white smoke emanate from the tower under a starry night sky featuring a large ornate compass.
prompt: A ruined stone tower and observatory built on the edge of a rocky cliff, with two winged angelic figures studying a large green fantasy map laid out on the stone ground. Magical teal banners reading 'LUNAR DUST FINDINGS' hang from the tower, floating books and swirling white ethereal smoke surround the structure. A large ornate compass floats in the starry night sky. Rolling hills and a distant castle visible in the background with a winding river. Intricate fantasy illustration style.
